spec.requirements:
# Requirements: Replace uuid@3 v4() with crypto.randomUUID()

## Context

- Deprecated: "uuid@10 and below is no longer supported. For ESM codebases, update to uuid@latest. For CommonJS codebases, use uuid@11 (but be aware this…" (npm.version.deprecated)
- 1 known vulnerability in 3.4.0 (GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq) (osv.querybatch.results[].vulns[].id)
- Successor: crypto.randomUUID. uuid@3 is unsupported; randomUUID is built into Node 14.17+ and browsers (curated.successors[uuid])

Scope: 3 source files scanned, 2 need changes.

## User stories

- As a maintainer, I want to stop depending on `uuid` so that I no longer ship an unmaintained dependency.
- As a reviewer, I want proof that behaviour is unchanged so that I can merge with confidence.

## Acceptance criteria (EARS)

- R1.1 WHEN the migration patch is applied THE SYSTEM SHALL contain no import or require of `uuid` in the 2 migrated files.
- R1.2 WHEN `package.json` is read THE SYSTEM SHALL no longer list `uuid` as a dependency, unless unmigrated usage remains.
- R2.1 WHEN the differential property-based tests run THE SYSTEM SHALL show identical observable behaviour between `uuid` and crypto.randomUUID for the covered operations over at least 100 generated inputs each.
- R2.2 IF a call site uses behaviour the recipe cannot express THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL leave a `TODO(revenant)` comment and list it in the migration notes instead of silently changing it.
- R3.1 WHERE the project's own test suite exists THE SYSTEM SHALL pass it unchanged after the migration.
spec.design:
# Design: Replace uuid@3 v4() with crypto.randomUUID()

## Approach

Apply the curated `uuid3-to-randomuuid` recipe: a deterministic source transform, a `package.json` edit. Verification is differential: the old and new implementations run side by side under fast-check.

## Flow

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Scan: uuid@3.4.0 flagged] --> B[Recipe uuid3-to-randomuuid]
  B --> C[Patch: 2 files]
  B --> D[Differential PBT]
  C --> E{Tests green?}
  D --> E
  E -- yes --> F[Open PR]
  E -- no --> G[Review TODO notes]
```

## Known limits

- Only v4() is migrated. v1/v3/v5 stay on uuid and the dependency is kept when they are used.
- Calls that pass options or a buffer to v4() cannot be expressed with randomUUID(); those files are left unchanged and reported.
- Differential tests compare format, version and variant bits and uniqueness; randomness quality is delegated to the platform CSPRNG.

## Files changed

- `src/audit.js`
- `src/server.js`
